info.title: Airstock API
info.description: Generated from the operation registry (packages/core). Every operation is also reachable over MCP or has a documented exception. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details.

post.summary: Create a shop
post.description: Creates a shop owned by the signed-in user, with one default warehouse and location named Main stock (PRD 3.1).

get.summary: List your shops
get.description: The shops where you are an active member, with your role in each.

get.summary: Get the current shop and your access
get.description: Returns the shop, your role and permissions, any location limits, and the scopes this connection was granted.

rateLimits.description: Requests allowed per second; more are refused with 429 and Retry-After.

post.summary: Change the shop name, time zone, or display units
post.description: Display units choose metric or imperial in the dashboard (PRD 3.1). Stored values keep the unit they were entered in. The currency cannot change once set.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

get.summary: Describe the catalog: fields, options, families, units, and limits
get.description: Read this first. Field keys, types, levels (product, variant, or both), and select options are what edit_catalog and search_catalog accept. Restricted fields appear only to members who manage the schema.

schema.description: Also list archived fields and families.

post.summary: Create a custom field
post.description: Adds a typed field to products, variants, or both (a variant inherits the product value until it has its own). Select fields take their options in `options`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

key.description: A slug used in imports, exports, and the API, such as care_instructions. Never changes.

min.description: integer, decimal, money, measurement: smallest value.

max.description: integer, decimal, money, measurement: largest value.

scale.description: decimal and money: decimal places, 0 to 6.

unitKind.description: measurement: weight, length, volume, or temperature.

defaultUnit.description: measurement: unit offered first, such as kg.

relationKind.description: relationship: what the link means, such as compatible_with or replaces.

config.description: Validation rules for the field type.

options.description: Option labels for single_select and multi_select fields.

defaultValue.description: Value given to new products in a family with this field.

visibility.description: restricted: only members who manage the schema see and change it.

post.summary: Change a field: label, rules, default, visibility, or archive and restore
post.description: The key, type, and level never change (see convert_field for safe type changes). An archived field keeps its values but takes no new ones.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

expectedVersion.description: Fails with a conflict if the field changed since.

min.description: integer, decimal, money, measurement: smallest value.

max.description: integer, decimal, money, measurement: largest value.

scale.description: decimal and money: decimal places, 0 to 6.

unitKind.description: measurement: weight, length, volume, or temperature.

defaultUnit.description: measurement: unit offered first, such as kg.

relationKind.description: relationship: what the link means, such as compatible_with or replaces.

config.description: Validation rules for the field type.

post.summary: Add, rename, reorder, archive, or restore the options of a select field
post.description: Options keep their IDs, so renaming one changes every record that has it. An archived option stays on existing records but is not offered for new choices.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

order.description: Option IDs in the new order; unlisted ones follow.

post.summary: Change a field to a compatible type, with a preview of affected records
post.description: Safe changes only: integer to decimal, single to multi select, text to rich text, decimal to money or to a measurement in a chosen unit. Run with preview true first; it changes nothing and shows how many records have a value.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

unit.description: decimal to measurement: the unit existing values are in.

post.summary: Create a product family
post.description: A family lists the fields its products use (each optional or required, in order and groups) and suggests option names and values. A product has at most one family; other fields stay available.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

suggestedOptions.description: Option names and values suggested for variants, such as Size: S, M, L.

post.summary: Change a product family, its fields, or archive and restore it
post.description: `fields` and `suggestedOptions` replace the whole list when given. Products in an archived family keep it, but it cannot be chosen for others.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

suggestedOptions.description: Option names and values suggested for variants, such as Size: S, M, L.

post.summary: Add a starter family: apparel, furniture, food, or spare parts
post.description: Copies the template into the shop as ordinary fields and a family, which you can then change. A field whose key already exists with the same type is reused, and missing options are added to it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

post.summary: Create a product with its default variant
post.description: Creates a product and the default variant that carries its SKU and price. `fields` takes custom field values by key (see describe_catalog); variant-level fields go to the default variant. Add size or colour variants afterwards with generate_variants. A SKU that matches an existing one after normalization is rejected.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

quantityScale.description: Decimal places allowed in stock quantities, 0 for whole units.

dimensions.description: Such as "120 x 60 x 75 cm" or {length, width, height, unit}.

barcode.description: The barcode printed on the item, such as its EAN-13. The type is detected from the code; a code another item or pack already has is refused.

acknowledgeSimilar.description: Products with similar names make the create fail with `similar_items_found` and the matches. Show them, and only after the person confirms it is a different product, retry with true.

title.description: Option values, such as "Black / M"; empty for a single variant.

incoming.description: Relationships other records have to this one, such as "replaces".

get.summary: Get a product with its variants, options, and field values
get.description: Look up by product ID, variant ID, or exact SKU. Each field value says whether it is the record’s own, inherited from the product, or cleared. Use these values as `expected` when you change them.

title.description: Option values, such as "Black / M"; empty for a single variant.

incoming.description: Relationships other records have to this one, such as "replaces".

post.summary: Search, filter, and sort the catalog
post.description: One page of products or variants. Combine `search`, a `filter` on any built-in or custom field (see describe_catalog for keys and options), and a `sort`; pass `nextCursor` back for the next page. Ask for custom field values with `fields`.

mode.description: variants: one row per variant (SKU, price, stock). products: one row per product, variant values summarised.

search.description: Matches SKUs exactly or by prefix, words in names and descriptions, and names with typos.

field.description: A field key, or a built-in: name, sku, price, status, family, tags, weight, available, created_at, updated_at, has_picture, has_shipping_package, has_barcode (booleans: op is, value true or false), supplier_sku (the preferred supplier’s SKU).

post.summary: Check a name, SKU, or barcode for duplicates before creating
post.description: Returns the record already using the SKU or barcode, and products with similar names. Creating with a taken SKU or barcode is refused; creating with a similar name needs acknowledgeSimilar.

excludeProductId.description: Leave this product out, when renaming it.

post.summary: Delete a saved view

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

post.summary: Change field values of one product and its variants
post.description: Each change names a field and the value you last read as `expected`. Changes to different fields never conflict; a field someone else changed since you read it returns `edit_conflict` with the current value and who changed it, and nothing is saved. To change many products at once, use a bulk preview.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

variantId.description: Leave out to change the product itself.

field.description: A built-in field (name, description, status, family, tags, weight, dimensions; on variants sku, price, weight, dimensions, baseUnit, quantityScale) or a custom field key.

expected.description: The value you last read for this field (null if it was empty). If someone changed it since, nothing is changed and you get a conflict with the current value.

value.description: The new value; null clears it.

inherit.description: Variants only: remove the variant’s own value so it inherits the product’s again.

title.description: Option values, such as "Black / M"; empty for a single variant.

incoming.description: Relationships other records have to this one, such as "replaces".

post.summary: Preview a change to many products or variants
post.description: Validates up to 500 records' changes without saving them and returns each value before and after. If everything is valid you get a previewId, valid for 15 minutes; show the preview, then commit it with bulk_commit.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

variantId.description: Leave out to change the product itself.

field.description: A built-in field or a custom field key, as in update.

value.description: The new value; null clears it.

inherit.description: Variants only: inherit the product’s value again.

previewId.description: Null when some changes are invalid; fix them and preview again.

post.summary: Commit a bulk edit preview
post.description: Applies every change in the preview, or none. If any record changed since the preview, the commit fails with preview_stale: preview again and show the new result before committing.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

post.summary: Set a product’s options and their values (rename, reorder, add, remove)
post.description: Give the full list of options in order. Existing options and values are matched by ID, then by name or label; ones left out are removed. Existing variants keep their values and take the first value of any new option. A value still used by a variant cannot be removed, and removing every option needs exactly one active variant.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

id.description: An existing option, to rename or reorder it.

values.description: Value labels in order, or {id, label} to rename an existing value.

title.description: Option values, such as "Black / M"; empty for a single variant.

incoming.description: Relationships other records have to this one, such as "replaces".

post.summary: Preview or create variants for every combination of option values
post.description: Give the options and values to combine (including the product’s existing options) and a SKU pattern such as "TS-{color}-{size}". With mode "preview" (the default) nothing is created: you get each combination, its SKU, and any duplicates. Run again with mode "create" to create the missing variants. A product’s single default variant keeps its ID, SKU, stock, and history and takes the first combination.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

id.description: An existing option, to rename or reorder it.

values.description: Value labels in order, or {id, label} to rename an existing value.

skuPattern.description: Placeholders are option names in braces. Without one, SKUs are the base SKU plus the values.

price.description: Price for new variants; defaults to the default variant’s.

state.description: kept: the default variant takes this combination.

duplicate.description: The SKU is already used, or repeats within this set.

title.description: Option values, such as "Black / M"; empty for a single variant.

incoming.description: Relationships other records have to this one, such as "replaces".

post.summary: Archive a product
post.description: Hides the product and its variants from new work. Its history and stock stay; nothing is deleted. A product with open reservations cannot be archived.

post.summary: Map an import’s columns and validate every row
post.description: Without a mapping, returns the columns and a suggested mapping. With one, validates every row without writing: creates (new SKUs), updates (matched by SKU), errors, and likely duplicates. Targets: product, name, description, status, family, tags, sku, barcode, price, weight, dimensions, field:<key>, option:<name>, stock:<locationId>, ignore.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

problems.description: The first 100 rows with errors or warnings.

post.summary: Commit a previewed import
post.description: Writes the valid rows of the last preview in chunks, as a job; rows with errors are skipped. Opening stock is received with the reason "opening stock". Follow progress with get_import.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

post.summary: Export products or variants as CSV
post.description: Exports what a catalog query returns (the same mode, search, filter, sort, and fields), in a format the import accepts. Runs as a job; the file is ready for 24 hours and deleted after 7 days. The person downloads it in the Airstock dashboard: Products, then Import, under Recent exports (or through the API).

post.summary: Create a warehouse or storage site
post.description: Owned, rented, or run by a third party. Rented and third-party sites record their operator and, with the storage.commercial.read permission, their contract. Add locations to hold stock.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per command. Retrying with the same key returns the original result without repeating the effect.

ownership.description: owned, rented, or third_party. New warehouses: owned.

operatorName.description: Who runs the site, for rented and third-party warehouses.

timezone.description: IANA time zone such as Europe/Berlin; null uses the shop time zone.

provider.description: The other system, such as shipbob.

providerRefs.description: This site’s IDs in other systems, such as a fulfillment partner.

operatingStatus.description: How the site is running. A record only; fulfillmentEligible decides allocation.

fulfillmentEligible.description: Whether orders may be allocated from here. Applies to everything inside it too.

amount.description: Decimal string, zero or more, at most 14 integer digits and 6 decimal places.

unit.description: What the amount is charged per, such as "pallet per week" or "order".

contract.description: Commercial terms. Needs the storage.commercial.read permission. Replaces the whole contract; null removes it. A record only, not billing.
Present only for members with the storage.commercial.read permission.

post.summary: Start uploading a picture or attachment
post.description: Declare the file name, type, size in bytes, and SHA-256 (hex). The answer has upload URLs valid for 15 minutes: PUT the original to the first; for images also PUT a thumbnail (WebP or JPEG, longest side up to 320 px) and a display image (up to 1,600 px). Then finalize. A wrong checksum, a file that is not what it says, or an oversize file is refused and the upload fails.
